scope: Protected gallery entry navigation and correlated browser request diagnostics. This is not a successful full-editor browser acceptance.

runtime.identityVerifiedBy: Read-back SHA-256 of the actual installed runtime file; the retained application directory name is not its current source version.
runtime.deploymentScope: The runtime file was patched in the existing application directory. This proof does not claim that every installed file matches sourceCommit. Temporary browser diagnostics were present separately.

collection.method: Read-only SSH log inspection followed by HTTPS GET requests to the exact configured origin. Authentication was loaded internally from the existing private configuration and was not output.
collection.sanitization: No credentials, authentication headers, cookies, IP addresses, request query strings, configuration contents, or response bodies are included.

browserRequestDiagnostics.source: Existing application stderr.log; the following three events were captured before the subsequent entry matrix.
browserRequestDiagnostics.interpretation: The successful actual iframe navigation is separately identified from the preceding GET fetch. HTTP 200 is not evidence that the browser committed or initialized the iframe document.

coverage: Activated cross-site and same-site entry GETs reach a strict inner handler.
Basic authentication, exact Host, HTTPS and Origin checks remain mandatory.
Cross-site iframes, subresources, nonactivated navigation, writes, HEAD, APIs and nonexact routes stay blocked.
Ordinary same-origin iframe requests retain existing behavior.
Diagnostics omit queries and sensitive headers and are capped at twenty events per process.
Existing gallery comment and approval authentication, Origin and CSRF contracts remain valid.
